title: MMEVALPRO: Calibrating Multimodal Benchmarks Towards Trustworthy and Efficient Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting 'Seeing-or-Not Comparison' tests (evaluating vision models with images vs. text-only models without images) and 'Answer Consistency Tests' using augmented question triplets (original, perception, and knowledge anchors) to detect if models are relying on textual shortcuts, data leakage, or educated guessing rather than genuine multimodal comprehension.
